sources.title: Koraidon ex — Mega Evolution Ascended Heroes 121（Orichalcum Fang）
sources.documentVersion: Card text as printed (Limitless card page); cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09
sources.supportsZh: “If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does N more damage.”：上个对手回合，己方任意一只宝可梦被招式造成的伤害击倒时追加伤害。

sources.title: Pokémon TCG Rulebook — damage vs. damage counters
sources.documentVersion: Official rulebook (Attack step; placing damage counters is not damage)
sources.supportsZh: “放置伤害指示物”不是“造成伤害”：被效果放置伤害指示物击倒，不算“被招式造成的伤害击倒”。

dataContractZh: 新条件 KNOCKED_OUT_BY_ATTACK_LAST_TURN（只接受 target，单只公开宝可梦；读的是 target 的拥有者）：上一个回合（对手的回合）里，这名玩家有宝可梦被招式伤害击倒即成立。
serverAuthorityZh: 服务器在击倒结算确认“被招式伤害击倒”时，在被击倒宝可梦拥有者的玩家状态上记下当时的回合数；条件只在当前回合数减 1 时成立。
limitations: “上个对手回合这只宝可梦受到招式伤害，追加同样多的伤害”等需要伤害数值的写法不在本条件内。
